svg.title: LEONARD E. MOORE — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Revolut’s valuation jumps 53% to $115B in new share sale as it prepares to launch US bank ◆ TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026: Doors open at 9 a.m. ET in Boston ◆ Canva lays off over 1,200 people amid slowing growth ◆ India’s EloElo nabs $80M from NBCUniversal to bet on the country’s rising microdrama market ◆ Anthropic is working on a system to prove AI models’ identity ◆ Data centers are turning to old jet engines as the wait for power grows ◆
